sampler: A brief is lofi_rl.brief.sample_brief(seed, index) (docs/COMPILER.md section 6).
Each field is its own keyed draw h = splitmix64(splitmix64(splitmix64(seed mod 2**64) ^ index) ^ field), fields energy 1, mood 2, tempo 3, tonic 4,
so brief i of a seed is the same however many briefs are drawn, and a stream is a seed and its indices.
held_out: Held-out means fresh samples of the same 9 prompts (D-021: in D-009, D-014 and the obedience claim).
The model sees only the cell, so all 9 prompts are the same in every stream.
Held-out briefs are kept apart only by fresh samples, rendered at tempi and tonics the model never reads.
No draw seed repeats anywhere in this file: across streams, briefs and draws.
excluded: None: every stream keeps every brief it selects, twins included.
The policy never reads bpm or tonic, and an exclusion would thin the 75-90 BPM centre (D-021 item 1).

range: The seed's indices [start, stop), in order.
stratified: Walk the seed from index 0 and take each brief whose energy x mood cell still has room; stop when every cell is full.
The chosen briefs are listed in stream order. read is how many indices were read, [0, read), so the last brief listed is index read - 1.
per_cell: The 9 cells in ENERGIES x MOOD_NAMES order (cells above): for n briefs the first n mod 9 cells take ceil(n / 9) and the others floor(n / 9).
Claude's default for the one rule D-021 item 1 leaves to the file (4 or 5 a cell for 40, 11 or 12 for 100, 30 for 270).

formula: key(seed, index) = splitmix64(splitmix64(splitmix64(seed mod 2**64) ^ index) ^ field), field = 0x64726177 (the ASCII bytes of "draw").
draw_seed(seed, index, k) = splitmix64(key(seed, index) ^ k) >> 33, the top 31 bits: 0 <= draw_seed < 2**31.
splitmix64 is lofi_rl.prng.splitmix64 (Vigna's SplitMix64, splitmix64(0) = 0xe220a8397b1dcdaf); ^ is XOR and >> a right shift, on 64-bit words.
key is the brief sampler's chain with a field of its own (the sampler's are 1-4); SplitMix64 is a bijection on 64-bit words,
so key is never the hash behind a field of its own brief.
use: Draw k of a brief (k = 0..7) is one vLLM request with n = 1 and SamplingParams(seed=draw_seeds[k]).
A use that needs m samples passing the gates takes the first m passing draws in k order; a brief still short after its draws is reported short, never drawn again under other seeds.
The measurement stream has no draws (draws 0): junk-rate seeds its engine as D-020 registered (junk.py), one request a brief, so the stream fixes its briefs only.
The seed depends only on the stream's seed, the brief's index and k, not on the checkpoint: draw k of a brief has one seed under every checkpoint, step 0 included.
With n > 1, vLLM 0.32 gives child i of a request the seed seed + i (vllm/v1/engine/parallel_sampling.py:81), not this table's.
D-021 item 1: these cover the step-0 samples, the checkpoint quads and the final A/B's <= 4 draws.
